summary: Creates a four-point rectangle with optional rounded corners and outputs no primitives, point primitives, lines, line strips, triangles, or quads. It can fill a camera view, match input bounds, create Tex/N attributes, and apply anchors and transforms.

key_params.name: modifybounds
key_params.note: Use connected input bounds as the base rectangle bounds

key_params.name: orient
key_params.note: XY, YZ, ZX, or Fill Camera View orientation

key_params.name: camera
key_params.note: Camera used for Fill Camera View mode

key_params.name: distfromcam
key_params.note: Distance from camera for camera-fill mode

key_params.name: cameraaspect
key_params.note: Aspect ratio used for Fill Camera View projection

key_params.name: cornersides
key_params.note: Number of sides for rounded corners

key_params.name: anchoru
key_params.note: Anchor left, middle, or right side at X=0

key_params.name: anchorv
key_params.note: Anchor bottom, middle, or top side at Y=0

key_params.name: texture
key_params.note: Create point or vertex texture coordinates

key_params.name: texturefit
key_params.note: Scale and position texture coordinates relative to the rectangle

common_gotchas: Fill Camera View requires a valid camera and aspect settings; otherwise the generated rectangle will not match view framing.
Rounded corners add points, so downstream point-index assumptions must account for cornersides.
Camera-fill background plates usually want quads or triangles, while line workflows need line strip/lines connectivity.
